decks.notes: Utilizing a combination of low-cost goblins and powerful tribal synergies, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. Key cards like Goblin Chieftain and Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker help to boost the creatures' power and provide additional utility, while cards like Munitions Expert and Sling-Gang Lieutenant offer removal and reach. Aether Vial helps to cheat creatures into play quickly, while the land base ensures consistent mana production for a relentless assault on the opponent.

The main idea of this deck is to use powerful land interactions and ramping spells to quickly bring out Primeval Titan and use its abilities to search for key lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva. This allows for a combo finish with multiple land triggers and powerful land-based abilities to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. The deck utilizes cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to further enhance its land ramping capabilities and ensure a swift win through a powerful and explosive combo.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can work together to create powerful combos and generate value. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can tutor for specific creatures to fit the situation, while cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide provide additional synergy and ways to generate advantage. The deck also includes key pieces like Blood Artist and Geralf's Messenger to help close out games with incremental damage or life drain. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive creature curve and enable quick, explosive plays.

This Goblin deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive board presence, utilizing cards like Goblin Chieftain and Sling-Gang Lieutenant to pump up and sacrifice Goblins for maximum damage. The deck also includes combo pieces like Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker and Conspicuous Snoop for additional synergy and explosive plays. With a mix of aggressive creatures and powerful tribal effects, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently, making it a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck revolves around quickly casting cheap spells to trigger the prowess ability of creatures like Stormwing Entity and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also filling up the graveyard to bring back Arclight Phoenix. With a focus on aggressive plays and efficient card draw/filtering, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and burn spells. The inclusion of Demilich and Ox of Agonas provide additional sources of card advantage and graveyard recursion, giving the deck resilience and flexibility in its game plan. Enjoy the fast-paced and dynamic gameplay of this Modern aggro deck!

This deck focuses on using cheap spells and creatures to apply pressure early in the game, while maintaining control with counterspells and removal. The key strategy is to quickly diminish your opponent's life total by efficiently using your resources and constantly threatening to disrupt their game plan. By combining aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer with powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell, you aim to overwhelm your opponent before they can stabilize. Additionally, cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help you dig for key pieces while fueling your graveyard for Delve spells like Unholy Heat.

This deck focuses on controlling the board utilizing a variety of spells and removal. It also includes cards that provide card advantage and allow for flexibility in casting spells. The archetype revolves around using key cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor, Counterspell, and Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up resources and value. The inclusion of companions like Yorion, Sky Nomad adds an extra layer of versatility and card advantage to ensure that the player maintains control of the game throughout its duration.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping into powerful Eldrazi creatures, using cards like Expedition Map and Urza's Tower to accelerate mana production. Chalice of the Void is used to disrupt opponents' strategies, while Karn, the Great Creator provides additional versatility and control elements. The Eldrazi creatures, such as Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer, put pressure on opponents early and can quickly close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive Eldrazi creatures and disruptive elements.

This deck focuses on assembling the powerful combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to quickly equip an indestructible and powerful creature. The key strategy involves efficiently tutoring for the combo pieces using Stoneforge Mystic, while protecting the combo with Giver of Runes and Teferi, Time Raveler. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional consistency in finding artifact pieces. By quickly assembling the combo, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a lethal, difficult-to-interact-with threat that can end the game in just a few swings.

The deck focuses on using control elements alongside powerful Elemental creatures to dominate the battlefield. With a mix of removal spells, card draw, and ramp, the deck aims to control the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with the synergy between Omnath, Locus of Creation, Risen Reef, and Fury. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking creatures and permanents for added advantage. Overall, the deck combines strong individual cards with a synergistic game plan to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a long game.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of powerful equipment and disruptive creatures to maintain board control and apply pressure on the opponent. It leverages cards like Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice and Batterskull, while also utilizing creatures like Grief and Solitude to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes cards like Ephemerate and Agadeem's Awakening to protect and recur key threats, ensuring a consistent presence on the battlefield. With a mixture of aggression and resilience, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents in a midrange battle.

This deck focuses on using The Underworld Cookbook and other artifact creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By utilizing cards like Shrapnel Blast and Galvanic Blast, this aggro deck can deal significant damage early on while maintaining board presence with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ovalchase Daredevil. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides extra value by searching for key artifacts, and the deck's mana base is designed to support its aggressive playstyle. The goal is to win the game quickly through a combination of direct damage and creature pressure.

The key concept of this deck is to maintain control of the board while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The deck utilizes cheap counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell to protect its threats, as well as removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with opposing threats. The deck aims to efficiently curve out with its cheap spells and efficient creatures, leveraging card advantage and tempo to overwhelm opponents in the early to mid game.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays, utilizing efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the board while creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent deal damage quickly and effectively. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Blood Moon and Spell Pierce to disrupt opponent's strategies. The mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells and creatures, allowing the deck to maintain pressure and tempo throughout the game. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly and decisively through a mix of burn, creatures, and disruption.
